CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. Cannot tell

2. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

3. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 1, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 17
   C. 34
   D. 22

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 21
   C. 90
   D. 30

7. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

8. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 24.5

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

13. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 105
   D. 44

15. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

16. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

17. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

18. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 100
   C. 50
   D. 11

19. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 77
   C. 36
   D. 18

21. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

22. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

23. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 12
   D. 16

24. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
